HEADLINE: Pursuant to Reg 30 and Reg 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 read with schedule III of the said regulations, we inform you that the Board ....
MORE:
Pursuant to Reg 30 and Reg 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 read with schedule III of the said regulations, we inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today, i.e. Friday, November 06, 2026, inter alia, has approved:
1. The Unaudited Standalone Financial Results along with Limited Review Report for the Quarter and Half Year Ended September 30, 2026 enclosed herewith as 'Annexure A'.
2. The related party transactions for the Quarter and Half Year Ended on 30th September, 2026.
3. Appointment of Mr. Arun Lodha as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) with effect from November 06, 2026
